user.title: Add Qubino wire pilot thermostat
user.description: Create a climate entity that drives a Qubino pilot wire module through its light entity.

data_description.heater: Light entity of the Qubino module that drives the radiator.
data_description.sensor: Temperature sensor that reflects the current room temperature.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional power sensor of the radiator. When set, the thermostat reports heating only while the radiator draws power.
data_description.value_frost: Brightness percentage for Frost Protection mode (default: 20%).

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads Qubino wire pilot thermostats from the YAML configuration.

invalid_preset.message: Preset {preset} is not available. Available presets: {presets}.

missing_heater.title: Qubino thermostat heater not found
missing_heater.description: {thermostat} controls {entity_id}, which does not exist. The thermostat stays unavailable until you select an existing light in the helper options.

missing_sensor.title: Qubino thermostat temperature sensor not found
missing_sensor.description: {thermostat} reads its temperature from {entity_id}, which does not exist. Select an existing sensor in the helper options.

missing_power_sensor.title: Qubino thermostat power sensor not found
missing_power_sensor.description: {thermostat} reads its power from {entity_id}, which does not exist. Select an existing sensor in the helper options, or clear it.
